diagnostics.message: [DF_RUNS_AS_ROOT] The final stage has no USER instruction, so the container runs as root unless the base image sets another user. Add a non-root USER before CMD.

[DF_CURL_PIPE_SHELL] A script is downloaded and run in one step ('curl -sfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aquasecurity/trivy/main/contrib/install.sh | sh'). Whatever the server returns at build time runs unchecked, as root. Download it, verify a checksum, then run it, or install a released package instead.
[DF_APK_UNPINNED_PACKAGES] Packages installed without a version: bash, curl, jq. Rebuilds may install different versions; pin them with name=version (or name~major.minor) for reproducible images.

[GHA_UNPINNED_ACTION] 'aquasecurity/trivy-action@master' uses the branch 'master', so whoever can push to it changes the code this workflow runs, with your repository's token and secrets. Pin a release tag or, safest, a full commit SHA.

[DF_APK_UNPINNED_PACKAGES] Packages installed without a version: git. Rebuilds may install different versions; pin them with name=version (or name~major.minor) for reproducible images. (run by RUN on line 8)

instructions.text:
RUN apk update && \
    apk add --no-cache bash curl jq && \
    curl -sfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aquasecurity/trivy/main/contrib/install.sh | sh -s -- -b /usr/local/bin

recommendations.title: Run the container as a non-root user
recommendations.explanation: A process running as root inside the container has more power if it is compromised. Create or reuse an unprivileged user and switch to it after the steps that need root.

proposed_change.description: Add a USER instruction before CMD/ENTRYPOINT (many base images already provide one, e.g. 'node' in node images).

recommendations.title: Verify downloaded scripts before running them
recommendations.explanation: Piping a download into a shell runs whatever the server sends, and a URL on a branch (such as /main/) can change between builds. Pin the URL to a release and check a published checksum first.

proposed_change.description: Download to a file, verify its SHA-256, then run it.
proposed_change.preview:
- curl -sfL <url> | sh -s -- <args>
+ curl -sfLo /tmp/install.sh <url-of-a-release>
+ echo "<sha256>  /tmp/install.sh" | sha256sum -c -
+ sh /tmp/install.sh <args>

recommendations.title: Pin package versions if builds must be reproducible
recommendations.explanation: Without versions, apk installs whatever the repository offers at build time. This is a tradeoff: pinned versions must be updated by hand.

proposed_change.description: Pin as name=version or name~major.minor, e.g. bash~<version>, curl~<version>, jq~<version>

recommendations.title: Pin the action to a release or commit
recommendations.explanation: A branch can be changed at any time, including by an attacker who takes over the action's repository (as happened to tj-actions/changed-files in 2025). A commit SHA cannot change; a release tag rarely does. Look up the release you want on the action's page.

proposed_change.description: Replace the branch with a full commit SHA (keep the version in a comment), or at least a release tag.
proposed_change.preview:
- uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
+ uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@<40-char commit SHA> # vX.Y.Z
